name: Insomnia Coach
one_liner: Insomnia Coach is a free five-week self-guided program from the VA, based on cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I).
best_for: People with ongoing insomnia who want to try CBT-I on their own
Anyone who wants a free, structured sleep program
not_for: Possible sleep apnea or other medical sleep problems
short_description: Insomnia Coach is a free five-week self-guided program from the VA, based on cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I).
long_description: Insomnia Coach is a free five-week self-guided program from the VA, based on cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I). A week-by-week plan with a sleep diary, personal feedback and 17 tools for restoring healthy sleep. Built by the VA's National Center for PTSD for veterans and anyone else with insomnia. Free, with no ads. What it includes: Five-week CBT-I training plan; Sleep diary; Personal sleep feedback; 17 sleep tools.

faqs.q: How much does Insomnia Coach cost?
faqs.a: Free. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Insomnia Coach before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Insomnia Coach replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Insomnia Coach is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Insomnia Coach?
faqs.a: Insomnia Coach is available on iPhone and Android.
